assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: square glossary illustration. Exactly three equal educational vignettes within one square composition, with soft white space separating them. First: two middle school students listen respectfully to each other with relaxed hands. Second: a student arrives with an organized backpack and notebook. Third: a student patiently rebuilds a small collapsed block model. Depict respect, responsibility, and perseverance as habits of work and learning. No academic grades, scores, letters, written words or labels. Natural coherent hairstyles; every visible arm attached to its own shoulder with one elbow and wrist; simple relaxed poses. Style: Warm clean editorial educational illustration, soft painterly texture on ivory background, muted teal, coral and ochre accents. Ages 11–14 when students are included. Clear uncluttered square composition, generous margins, suitable as a glossary thumbnail. Coherent anatomy and hair. No readable text, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks. Native app supplies the term and definition.
